_doc: Hand-verified prices where the Wolt menu API disagrees with the price the live wolt.com page shows. Applied to that venue's Wolt offer at merge time (scripts/merge-souvlaki-sources.mjs), and cleared of the 'choose size' flag so the venue ranks. Re-check against the live page before extending; delete an entry once the API matches the page.

overrides.note: live wolt.com page: pork souvlaki 8.00, mix 8.00, chicken 8.50 (menu API lists 7.50/7.50/8.00); Bolt lists 8.00 for the same pork souvlaki

Bolt menu: Half (free) / Regular +2.25 (mix +1.95, chicken +2.00) / Large; the scan read the 'Extra Pita +0.50' extra as the size (6.20). Wolt lists the same regular price 7.95. Extractor fixed too; delete once a fresh Bolt scan shows these values.
same kitchen and menu as Finitzia Taverna (Athinas 23); live page 8.00/8.00/8.50 vs API 7.50/7.50/8.00; Bolt lists 8.00
